from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        title = "Real-World Application: ECC Memory"
        lines = [
            "Hamming codes power Error Correction Code (ECC) memory.",
            "They protect servers and deep-space communication from corruption.",
            "Self-healing data keeps our digital world running smoothly."
        ]

        pcb_color = "#A9A9A9"
        chip_color = "#444444"
        pin_color = "#D4AF37" # Gold-ish

        ram_pcb = Rectangle(width=4, height=1.5, fill_opacity=1, color=pcb_color, stroke_width=2)
        
        # Memory Chips
        chips = VGroup(*[
            Rectangle(width=0.6, height=0.8, fill_opacity=1, color=chip_color, stroke_width=1)
            for _ in range(4)
        ]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.2)
        chips.move_to(ram_pcb.get_center())

        # Pins
        pins = VGroup(*[
            Rectangle(width=0.05, height=0.2, fill_opacity=1, color=pin_color, stroke_width=0)
            for _ in range(30)
        ]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.05)
        pins.next_to(ram_pcb, DOWN, buff=0)

        ram_stick = VGroup(ram_pcb, chips, pins)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Hamming codes power Error Correction Code (ECC) memory.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW)
        self.place_in_area(ram_stick, "B2", "E5", scale_factor=0.9)
        self.play(FadeIn(ram_stick))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # They protect servers and deep-space communication from corruption.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(CYAN)

        # Create cosmic rays (cyan particles)
        particles = VGroup(*[
            Dot(radius=0.05, color=CYAN)
            for _ in range(8)
        ])
        
        # Position particles off-screen to the right/top
        for p in particles:
            start_pos = self.grid["A6"] + np.array([np.random.uniform(-1, 2), np.random.uniform(-1, 2), 0])
            p.move_to(start_pos)

        # Animate particles hitting the RAM
        particle_anims = []
        for p in particles:
            # Move towards random points on the RAM stick
            target = ram_pcb.get_center() + np.array([np.random.uniform(-1.5, 1.5), np.random.uniform(-0.5, 0.5), 0])
            particle_anims.append(p.animate.move_to(target).set_opacity(0))
        
        self.play(*particle_anims, run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Self-healing data keeps our digital world running smoothly.
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(GREEN)

        # Select one chip to "fail" (corrupt bit)
        target_chip = chips[2]
        error_indicator = Square(side_length=0.2, fill_opacity=1, color=RED, stroke_width=0)
        error_indicator.move_to(target_chip.get_center())

        # Show bit turning red (corruption)
        self.play(FadeIn(error_indicator))
        self.play(Flash(error_indicator, color=RED, flash_radius=0.3))
        self.wait(0.5)

        # Correction animation: Red to Green
        self.play(error_indicator.animate.set_color(GREEN))
        self.play(Indicate(error_indicator, color=GREEN))
        
        # Final flourish - particles clearing up or glowing
        self.play(FadeOut(error_indicator, scale=1.5), run_time=1)
        
        self.wait(2)
